name: aipe-monorepo
description: Spec workflow CLI for AI-assisted development. Root package wires the github install path; the publishable package lives in cli/.

scripts._comment_prepare: Runs at install time, including for `npm install -g github:rlynjb/aipe#main`. Three things to know: (1) `--global=false` is critical because npm propagates npm_config_global=true into nested installs during a global prepare, which silently no-ops most deps. (2) `--include=dev` is needed because typescript+tsx are devDeps and the build needs them. (3) We deliberately don't use workspaces here because npm install -g doesn't honor them.
scripts.prepare: cd cli && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --include=dev --global=false && npm run build
